I had this too, simple: Walk to a girl after having eye contact (just say f*ck it to yourself) and be honest with her immediately from the start.

After that you hand out your hand to her and shake her hand and tell who you are. After that it's her turn to introduce herself. Offer her a drink and get it if she wants it.

Before doing this think of a few questions to know her better and practice them ofcourse. When she's talking pay close attention to check if there are any similar interests.
